cohort: The study included 80 neonates exhibiting clinical signs of neonatal jaundice, characterized by a yellowish appearance, at a Tertiary Care Teaching Institute.
finding: A notable statistical relationship was observed between transcutaneous bilirubin (TCB) levels and the severity of hyperbilirubinemia, which was also found to be more prevalent in males.
mod_finding: 60% of the cases involved full-term normal deliveries, while 40% were delivered via caesarean section.
cross-section timing: At the time of presentation with clinical signs of neonatal jaundice in the postnatal period.
